description: Calculation-based LED selection by package, CCT, and operating current. If there is no current, call led_catalog_search (price list without calculation) or ask for the current. Default: 5 items, maximum 10 — if the user asks for more, call with limit 10. Without availability — stock and on order only; availability.source=all — all items. Without sort — lowest cost per lumen; with thresholds.target_flux the sort is always flux-distance-asc, and flux-distance-asc without it is rejected as sort-invalid. Show the result as the table from the response `table` field — it is the same as on the site. Pass hidden_message to the user; do not promise an order.

availability.description: availability { source, min_quantity }: stock — stock only, stock-and-order — stock and on order, all — all items without quantity filtering. Field omitted — stock and on order, minimum 1; when a part number is specified, availability is not checked. Availability does not guarantee that an order can be placed

min_quantity.description: how many units must be available

source.description: where to count availability: stock, stock-and-order, or all

catalog.description: price list conditions: package, CCT, and optional refinements

marking_match.description: exact — the full part number is given, search only for it; field omitted — search by the start of the part number

min_quantity.description: quantity specified by the user; 0 if not specified

max_unit_price.description: maximum price per unit in this currency

sort.description: result sorting: price-per-lumen-usd-asc — lowest cost per lumen (USD/lm), price-usd-asc — lowest price per unit (USD), price-cny-asc — lowest price per unit (CNY), efficacy-desc — highest efficacy, flux-desc — highest flux, flux-distance-asc — closest to the specified target flux, only with target_flux; default price-per-lumen-usd-asc, with thresholds.target_flux always flux-distance-asc

temperature.description: solder-point temperature in °C; degrees without qualification mean this temperature

max_voltage.description: maximum forward voltage at the operating current, in V

min_efficacy.description: minimum efficacy at the operating current, in lm/W

min_flux.description: minimum luminous flux of one LED at the operating current, in lm

target_flux.description: required luminous flux of one LED, in lm: items within ±10% remain, closest first

name: led_select
